description: This file defines a Java class 'Transistor' which extends Akka Streams' GraphStage to implement a flow component that regulates element flow based on credits, modeled after a bipolar junction transistor. It includes internal logic for handling inlets, outlets, and flow control.

classes.name: Transistor
classes.description: A generic Akka Streams GraphStage that models a transistor-like flow regulator with inlets for collector and base, and an outlet for emitter.

classes.name: TransistorLogic
classes.description: Inner class extending GraphStageLogicWithLogging that manages flow control logic, including credits, demand, and inflight elements.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new Transistor instance.

methods.name: shape
methods.description: Returns the shape of the GraphStage, including its inlets and outlets.

methods.name: createLogic
methods.description: Creates the logic instance for this GraphStage.

methods.name: preStart
methods.description: Initializes the stage by pulling from the base inlet.
